aboutGame.title: What Is the Shorekeeper?
paragraphs: The Shorekeeper is a 5-star Spectro Resonator in Wuthering Waves who wields a Rectifier and fills the healer and support slot. In the story she is the Guardian of the Black Shores and is known as the Second Instance, a being described as formed from Sonoro Spheres and high-purity Remnant Energy crystals who guides the Tethys System and appears only when the Black Shores face a crisis.

In combat she is a buff engine rather than a damage dealer. Her Resonance Liberation, End Loop, deploys the Stellarealm field that heals the team and raises Crit Rate and Crit DMG, while her Outro Skill, Binary Butterfly, passes those bonuses to whoever swaps in next. Because those buffs scale with her Energy Regen, this wiki focuses on the stats, Echoes, teams, and rotations that keep her field online.

faq.title: Shorekeeper Wiki FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about the Shorekeeper in Wuthering Waves.

items.question: Who is the Shorekeeper in Wuthering Waves?
items.answer: The Shorekeeper is a 5-star Spectro Resonator who wields a Rectifier and fills the healer and support slot. She is the Guardian of the Black Shores, known as the Second Instance, and she debuted in version 1.3 on the Till the Sea Turns Clear Convene.

items.question: What stats should a Shorekeeper build focus on?
items.answer: Energy Regen and HP%. The Shorekeeper does not need ATK or Crit stats because her value comes from healing and the Crit Rate and Crit DMG buffs her Outro Skill passes to the next Resonator, both of which scale with Energy Regen and HP.

items.question: How much Energy Regen does the Shorekeeper need?
items.answer: Most players land between 200% and 230% Energy Regen for reliable uptime, while 230% to 250% approaches the ceiling of her Energy Regen-scaling buffs. Below 180% her End Loop misses rotations and the buffs fall off.

items.question: What is the Shorekeeper's best Echo set?
items.answer: Rejuvenating Glow is the default set because it boosts healing and converts it into a team ATK buff. Moonlit Clouds is the main alternative when you cannot reach your Energy Regen target on the Shorekeeper.

items.question: When does the Shorekeeper banner return?
items.answer: The Shorekeeper is a limited five-star, so her banner only returns when Kuro Games schedules a rerun. She debuted in version 1.3 and returned in a version 2.2 rerun, so check the official Wuthering Waves channels for the next window.
